hypothesis: Real same-intent continuation beyond the demonstration interval will expose consequences of premature release and reduce reliance on an unsupported tail value. This is a continuing-task partial-episode-bootstrap experiment, not timeout-as-failure supervision.

unchanged.reward: skill_aligned_v1; gamma .999 per actual control, potential .2, six physically achieved controls for success
unchanged.timeout: UNKNOWN with bootstrap; never a FAILED label
unchanged.actor_input: Only actual RGB/proprio and fixed task/skill conditions; no simulator truth, time budget or privileged feedback
unchanged.gradient_boundary: 322 native FM action-expert tensors and separate detached-feature critic only; planner/vision/VLM frozen
unchanged.optimizer_resume: Exact saved actor/critic/Adam and counters; explicit changed rollout metadata
unchanged.case_reference_intervals: Keep original manifests/proofs/source intervals unchanged; extension applies only to actual TRAIN execution

entry_gate: Old window must close cleanly. A new clean Git worktree, exact final20 SHA and six freshly restored baseline episodes require physical/media review and explicit baseline acceptance before update21.
measurements: At update0, every4 new updates and final update, evaluate all six original fixed-horizon probes; no evaluation data reaches the optimizer.
Report all three skill counts, including retention regressions. No checkpoint promotion based on a chosen successful video or training loss.
Compare reward/GAE/critic-tail decomposition on actual completed TRAIN episodes and original-time-prefix controls, with unmodified physical success thresholds.
Record original and extended policy deadlines, control ACKs, every native RGB/proprio boundary, model/version identity and all first failures.
interpretation: Forty updates define a learning-curve observation window, not a reset quota, goal endpoint or permission to auto-expand to100 tasks. A repeated six-probe improvement is only a development signal. Any usability claim additionally requires fresh predeclared seeds and legal held-out starts, and preservation of the other skills.
stopping: Stop on real control/identity/reward mismatch, changed cold starts, nonfinite/unsafe KL updates, a foreign primary GPU or insufficient disk. If the method does not improve, preserve the negative result and investigate targets/exploration rather than automatically increasing actor LR or lowering success criteria.
